messages:
Nia: Drafting a new field one-pager 'Fortify Deploy' 1 short launch assets + benchmark blurbs. Goal: enterprise buyers who care about security, SLAs, and deployment flexibility. Link: https://redwood.internal/briefs/fortify (internal).

Owen: Nice name. Quick ask: pick one crisp stat for the hero line. Customers like a percent they can measure.

Priya: Recommend: "~40% lower inference cost and 30% faster tail latency vs typical hosted runs (conservative)." Keeps messaging punchy.

Marco: Bench runs were on Dedicated with quantization + caching. Will attach 2 PNGs and a 3-row table for the one-pager.

Nia: Routing required: field wants inbound tags that indicate deployment mode interest + urgency. Proposed snippet for ops intake:
```yaml
inbound:
  tags: ["enterprise","FortifyDeploy","secure","vpc","onprem","dedicated","SLA","eval-kit"]
  assign: sales-eng
  priority: high
  funnel_label: evaluation-request
  intake_note: "include compliance needs and sample workload"
```

Owen: Please split 'secure' into 'security' and 'compliance' tags so we can route to the right AE. Also add 'nda-needed' optional tag.

Priya: Webinar headline (short): "Fortify Deploy: secure, predictable inference for regulated apps" Webinar blurb: "Join a 45-minute walk-through: architecture patterns, benchmark deep-dive, and how to run a free evaluation on your workload. Live Q&A with product and field." Agenda: 1) serving architecture & SLA options 2) benchmark stories 3) evaluation kit demo + next steps.

Marco: Social post (short): "New one-pager: Fortify Deploy 1 how teams secure inference, cut costs, and meet SLAs. Sign up for the webinar: [link + UTM]."

Nia: CTA for one-pager: "Request a Fortify evaluation kit 1 we'll test a sample workload and deliver a tailored ops report." Route to funnel_label above.

ops-bot: Webinar slot requested: 2026-06-02 10:00 PT 1 request ID 5582.

Owen: I'll tidy the hero stat and provide a tiny decision flow for deployment modes. Priya 1 can you add a short SLA comparison callout?

Priya: Yep. I'll add: "Dedicated: 99.9% uptime SLA; Private: contractual SLA; Hosted: regional fallback + best-effort."

Nia: Perfect. If no objections I'll publish internal brief tomorrow AM and kick routing to ops. Owners: copy (Priya), benchmarks (Marco), routing (Owen), webinar comms (Nia). :white_check_mark:
